units.source_text: 看起来比较舒缓的斜坡，只有四面，像圆锥内侧的沙壁。

en.t: There were only four slopes that looked relatively gentle, like sand walls on the inside of a cone.

units.source_text: 若按乐观的观测，有五十度左右。

en.t: By an optimistic estimate, they were about fifty degrees.

units.source_text: 观测得细致一点，也许在四十五度左右。

en.t: Measured a little more carefully, they might have been around forty-five degrees.

units.source_text: 他小心翼翼，试着踏出第一步。

en.t: He carefully tried taking the first step.
For every step he took, he slid half a step down.

units.source_text: 反正努力一下，像是能攀上去。

en.t: In any case, it seemed he could climb up if he made a little effort.
